::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
One of India's earliest fabless chip design companies. Designs SoCs for 5G broadcast convergence and satellite communications.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Software-defined radio SoCs for 5G NR broadcast, ATSC 3.0, and satellite-terrestrial convergence.
